title: Membership & Subscription Website – Build Exclusive Communities | Lovable

facts.fact: Vendor's FAQ says free users can start public projects and have a limited number of AI credits, while paid users can create private projects and have more AI credits.
facts.quote: Free users can start public projects, and have a limited number of AI credits. Paid users can create private projects and have more AI credits.

facts.fact: Lovable's vendor example lists the cost of the prompt 'Make the button gray' (updates the button styles) as 0.50 credits.
facts.quote: | “Make the button gray” | Updates the button styles | 0.50 |

facts.fact: Lovable's vendor example lists the cost of the prompt 'Remove the footer' (removes the footer component) as 0.90 credits.
facts.quote: | “Remove the footer” | Removes the footer component | 0.90 |

facts.fact: Lovable's vendor example lists the cost of the prompt 'Add authentication with sign up and login' as 1.20 credits.
facts.quote: | “Add authentication with sign up and login” | Adds authentication pages and logic, updates routes | 1.20 |

facts.fact: Lovable's vendor example lists the cost of the prompt 'Build me a landing page, use images' (3 generated images, theme, 5 sections) as 1.70 credits.
facts.quote: | “Build me a landing page, use images” | Creates a landing page with 3 generated images, theme, and 5 sections | 1.70 |

facts.fact: In Lovable's Plan Mode, each message costs 1 credit.
In Lovable's Default Mode, credit cost varies based on task complexity rather than being a fixed amount.
facts.quote: **Default Mode:**credits vary based on task complexity

facts.fact: Per Lovable's FAQ, Pro and Business subscriptions include credit grants for building and hosting with Cloud, in addition to the credit balance.
facts.quote: In addition to your credit balance, Pro and Business subscriptions include grants for building and hosting with Cloud.

facts.fact: Lovable states that the value of a credit and its consumption rate depend on the subscription plan and feature used, and credits are not necessarily equal in value across different plans.
facts.quote: The value of a credit and the rate at which they are consumed for a given action depend on your subscription plan and the feature used, and credits are not necessarily equal in value across different plans.
